title: Asiad: EJ Obiena to lead PH’s medal hopes in athletics
summary: EJ Obiena will defend his gold medal while also trying to break his own Asian Games record in the men’s pole vault as he leads a 24-member Philippine athletics team in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Games.
